landcover.limitations: Built-up class is a land-cover proxy, not measured imperviousness. Context box is not a flood catchment. 2021 cover is static and may have changed.
landcover.method: Native categorical WorldCover pixels in a 500 m by 500 m context box; fractions of valid pixel counts.
landcover.resolution: WorldCover 2021 v200 10 m; nearest categorical sampling, max_size 1024

vegetation.limitations: Dated vegetation context, not live vegetation or vegetation at the historical flood event. No uncertainty or flood effect is calibrated.
vegetation.method: BOA=(DN+band offset)/quantification; NDVI=(B08-B04)/(B08+B04); accept SCL vegetation/bare/water only
vegetation.resolution: Single nearest 10 m red/NIR pixels and native 20 m SCL class at a landmark; not a site area mean
vegetation.scene_selection: Lowest scene cloud cover among first eight results ordered by cloud cover, 1 August–31 October 2026

vegetation.resolution: Single nearest 10 m red/NIR pixels and native 20 m SCL class at a landmark; not a site area mean
vegetation.scene_selection: Lowest scene cloud cover among first eight results ordered by cloud cover, 1 August–31 October 2026

landcover.limitations: Built-up class is a land-cover proxy, not measured imperviousness. Context box is not a flood catchment. 2021 cover is static and may have changed.
landcover.method: Native categorical WorldCover pixels in a 500 m by 500 m context box; fractions of valid pixel counts.
landcover.resolution: WorldCover 2021 v200 10 m; nearest categorical sampling, max_size 1024
